name: Prince Edward Island Provincial Nominee Program (PEI PNP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Prince Edward Island Provincial Nominee Program (PEI PNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)
